reply.text:
I'm sorry your shins are achy. That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so please get it looked at before you load them further. I can't tell you what it is or how much rest it needs.

What I can do is change the training around it. I can swap the runs for bike sessions this week, and I'll do that with the program edit once you confirm which runs you mean, or tell me to move all of this week's runs to the bike.
